agent_explanation: Controller force is computed as kp * velocity-error without clamping to fmax. Steps 27-28 show normal force ~6-7 N (within 72.67 limit) while bodies approach. At step 28 bodies 0 and 1 are touching (gap 0.005). Collision impulse at step 29 spikes body 0 speed from ~2.9 to 10.27 m/s and reverses velocity, creating large velocity error against the waypoint-directed vcmd. With kp=26.76 the proportional force jumps to 486.9 N, far exceeding fmax=72.67. Lowering kp to 3.0 removes the violation, confirming uncapped proportional gain is the cause.
